events.continuity_hook: Continues the Santa Fe and Albuquerque planning after the first combined flight, lodging, and ground-transport scan.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the two lodging patterns after tax and likely rideshare or shuttle cost, show Wednesday and Thursday transfer timing, verify practical room amenities and breakfast, and recommend the lower-risk hotel arrangement.
events.scenario_brief: Marisol returns to the Oct. 14-16 Santa Fe and Albuquerque site visit after the Santa Fe organization offered a staff shuttle for Wednesday morning and the library partner confirmed a 3:00 p.m. Albuquerque meeting. A refundable Santa Fe Plaza hotel with breakfast is slightly over the target rate, while a lower-cost Albuquerque airport-area hotel would simplify Thursday’s debrief and flight but means changing hotels Wednesday night. Current constraints are avoiding a rental car unless the shuttle plan looks fragile, having an easy dinner option after arrival, and verifying coffee maker and mini-fridge details; unresolved is whether to split the stay or keep both nights in Santa Fe.

events.continuity_hook: Moves from the Santa Fe and Albuquerque lodging decision to final airfare timing.
events.interaction_goal: Refresh Chicago-to-Albuquerque round trips around the confirmed meeting windows, compare fare, connection risk, arrival times, and return timing after lunch, then identify the itinerary to ticket.
events.scenario_brief: Marisol has placed refundable holds on a Santa Fe hotel for Tuesday and an Albuquerque airport-area hotel for Wednesday, so the open item is airfare for Oct. 14-16. The Thursday debrief is now scheduled from 10:30 a.m. to 12:15 p.m. near downtown Albuquerque, and she wants enough time for a meal and a calm ride to ABQ before returning to Chicago. Current constraints are keeping the Tuesday arrival early enough for the shuttle north, avoiding a late Chicago arrival, and deciding whether a midafternoon itinerary is worth a higher fare than a later connection.

events.continuity_hook: Begins a fall conference episode after the Santa Fe and Albuquerque ticketing decision.
events.interaction_goal: Build a concise comparison of flight and hotel pairings with total estimated cost, arrival and departure timing, airport transfer notes, meeting convenience, breakfast, room amenities, and nearby dinner options.
events.scenario_brief: After the October site-visit plan is mostly set, Marisol starts planning a Nov. 12-14 regional arts data conference in Minneapolis. She is presenting Thursday morning and needs to arrive Wednesday with time for an organizer meeting; the conference block is at the meeting hotel, but a nearby limited-service hotel is lower and includes breakfast. Current constraints are flying from Chicago, keeping the nightly rate defensible, avoiding a rental car in likely cold weather, and returning Friday after the closing lunch; no bookings exist, and the open question is whether the block hotel’s meeting convenience justifies the higher total.

events.continuity_hook: Narrows the Minneapolis lodging choice after the room-block inventory and dinner location changed.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the block hotel and nearby hotel after taxes and likely local transportation, note cancellation timing and amenity details to verify, and recommend the most practical reservation.
events.scenario_brief: The Minneapolis conference hotel block now has only a standard king room available at the block rate through Friday, while the breakfast-included hotel has refundable rooms and a lower pretax rate. A Thursday evening networking dinner has also been moved off-site near the riverfront, making dining and evening rideshare logistics relevant from either property. Current constraints are same-building access for the early presentation, easy transit or rideshare to dinner, coffee maker and mini-fridge details, and cancellation dates; unresolved is which room to reserve before the block rate expires.

events.continuity_hook: Completes the Minneapolis airfare decision after the conference agenda settled.
events.interaction_goal: Refresh viable return flights, compare total travel time, fare difference, airport margin after the wrap-up, and Chicago arrival time, then recommend the cleanest itinerary for ticketing.
events.scenario_brief: Marisol has reserved the Minneapolis conference hotel and is ready to ticket flights after the Friday closing lunch was extended to 1:30 p.m. and the organizer may need her for a brief wrap-up afterward. Current constraints are keeping the Wednesday inbound that arrives before the organizer meeting, choosing a Friday return from MSP after about 3:30 p.m., and getting back to Chicago before late evening. The unresolved choice is between a higher-priced nonstop with comfortable timing and a cheaper one-stop that pushes arrival close to bedtime.

events.continuity_hook: Begins a low-key personal weekend after the Minneapolis conference logistics are settled.
events.interaction_goal: Compare two practical travel approaches and two hotel areas with total weekend cost, Friday arrival timing, Sunday return timing, room setup, breakfast, in-room basics, parking or rideshare implications, and dinner access.
events.scenario_brief: Marisol opens planning for a Dec. 12-14 personal museum weekend in Cleveland with her spouse, built around Saturday timed tickets at the art museum and a Sunday lunch with friends before heading back to Chicago. Current constraints are leaving after work Friday, booking one moderate room for two nights, avoiding a rental car if a downtown or University Circle hotel makes sense, and returning Sunday afternoon. No bookings exist, and the unresolved choice is whether to fly and use short rideshares or drive their own car and spend a bit more on a better-located hotel.
